title: Whole skeleton
blurb: Every bone of the body in one model — the place to start when you need to see where a region sits.

title: Muscle attachments
blurb: Origins and insertions painted onto the bones. The fastest way to stop memorising attachment lists blindly.

title: Typical vertebra
blurb: The parts of a typical vertebra — body, pedicles, laminae, processes and the vertebral foramen.

title: Skull
blurb: The complete skull with every named bone, foramen and suture.

title: Skull, colour-coded
blurb: The same skull with each bone in its own colour — much easier when you are first learning which bone is which.

title: Exploded skull
blurb: The skull pulled apart so you can see how the individual bones interlock at the sutures.

title: Skull base, colour-coded
blurb: The floor of the cranial cavity — anterior, middle and posterior cranial fossae and the foramina passing through them.

title: Muscles of thorax, abdomen & back
blurb: The trunk wall in layers — from trapezius and latissimus dorsi down to the deep intrinsic back muscles and the abdominal wall.

title: Pelvic floor & perineum
blurb: Levator ani, the urogenital diaphragm and the perineal pouches — a region that is very hard to picture from flat diagrams.

title: Inguinal & femoral canal
blurb: The walls, rings and contents of the inguinal canal, with the femoral canal alongside it.

title: Hernia surgery view
blurb: The same region reduced to the structures a surgeon must identify when repairing an inguinal or femoral hernia.

title: Inguinal ligament
blurb: The inguinal ligament and what passes above and below it.

title: Upper limb, complete
blurb: Shoulder to fingertips in one model — bones, muscles, vessels and nerves, split into pectoral girdle, arm, forearm and hand.

title: Upper limb bones
blurb: Just the bones and cartilages, with the soft tissue stripped away — for osteology practicals.

title: Shoulder, complete
blurb: The shoulder region in full — glenohumeral joint, pectoral girdle, muscles, and the vessels and nerves crossing it.

title: Shoulder & pectoral girdle joints
blurb: Glenohumeral, acromioclavicular and sternoclavicular joints with their capsules and ligaments.

title: Rotator cuff
blurb: Supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis — the four muscles that hold the humeral head in place.

title: Axio-appendicular muscles
blurb: The muscles connecting the trunk to the upper limb — pectoralis major and minor, trapezius, latissimus dorsi, serratus anterior.

title: Scapulohumeral muscles
blurb: The muscles running from the scapula to the humerus, including deltoid and the rotator cuff.

title: Arm muscles
blurb: The anterior and posterior compartments of the arm — biceps, brachialis, coracobrachialis and triceps.

title: Elbow, complete
blurb: The elbow joint, cubital fossa and the structures crossing it.

title: Forearm, anterior compartment
blurb: The flexor-pronator group in its superficial, intermediate and deep layers.

title: Hand & wrist, complete
blurb: Carpals, metacarpals and phalanges with the intrinsic muscles, palmar arches and every named branch of the median and ulnar nerves.

title: Hand & wrist bones
blurb: The eight carpal bones, metacarpals and phalanges on their own — for learning the carpus.

title: Hand & wrist joints
blurb: Radiocarpal, intercarpal, carpometacarpal and interphalangeal joints with their ligaments.

title: Brachial plexus & branches
blurb: Roots, trunks, divisions, cords and terminal branches — the plexus laid out in 3D instead of as a flat wiring diagram.

title: Brachial plexus at the shoulder
blurb: The plexus shown in place among the muscles and vessels of the shoulder and axilla.

title: Median nerve
blurb: The whole course of the median nerve and everything it supplies.

title: Ulnar nerve
blurb: The ulnar nerve from cord to fingertips, including its vulnerable points at the elbow and wrist.

title: Radial nerve
blurb: The radial nerve, its spiral groove course and the posterior interosseous branch.

title: Axillary nerve
blurb: The axillary nerve winding round the surgical neck of the humerus to reach deltoid.

title: Musculocutaneous nerve
blurb: The musculocutaneous nerve piercing coracobrachialis and supplying the anterior arm.

title: Lower limb, complete
blurb: Hip to foot in one model — gluteal region, thigh compartments, leg and the arches of the foot.

title: Hip, complete
blurb: The hip joint with its capsule and ligaments, the gluteal muscles and the structures leaving the pelvis.

title: Knee, complete
blurb: Cruciate and collateral ligaments, menisci and the popliteal fossa — the joint students are asked about most.

title: Ankle & foot, complete
blurb: The ankle mortise, tarsal bones, retinacula and the tendons passing behind the malleoli.
